subject: general
question: Which Article of the Constitution of India was amended in 2002 and a clause 'k' was inserted that said "who is a parent or guardian to provide opportunities for education to his child or, as the case may be, ward between the age of six and fourteen years."?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 51 A.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 51 A** of the Constitution of India was amended in **2002 **and a **clause 'k'** was inserted that said "who is a parent or guardian to provide **opportunities for education **to his child or, as the case may be, ward between the age of **six and fourteen years.**"
 
• Article 51 A of the Constitution of India is a** fundamental duty.**
 
• The amendment of Article 51 A was a significant step towards ensuring that every child in India **receives education**.
 
• This amendment also emphasizes the role of** parents and guardians** in providing education to their children.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 44 A **deals with the provision of a** uniform civil code **for the citizens of India.
 
• The Indian Constitution contains **448 articles** (initially there were 395 articles). 
 
• The responsibilities of the three main branches of government—the **legislative, executive, and judicial branches**—as well as the distinct powers of the** federal and state governments **are covered in the** articles** of the constitution.
